parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
Reaction 1 in Fig. 4.1 takes place in the presence of sunlight.

$$\text{C}_3\text{H}_8 + \text{Cl}_2 \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{Cl} + \text{HCl}$$

The reaction takes place via initiation, propagation and termination steps.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Name the mechanism shown by reaction 1.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Complete the mechanism for reaction 1.

Construct equations to describe the steps of the mechanism.

initiation $\text{Cl}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{Cl}\bullet$

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Reaction 1 is initiated by the bond fission of $\text{Cl}_2$.

State the type of bond fission shown in the initiation step.

parts.label: (a)(iv)
(a)(v)
parts.text:
The molecular formula of $\mathbf{Q}$ is $\text{C}_3\text{H}_6\text{Cl}_2$.

Identify the types of structural isomerism and stereoisomerism that a molecule with molecular formula $\text{C}_3\text{H}_6\text{Cl}_2$ can show.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the reagent and solvent required for reaction 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: Reaction 3 takes place when $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$ is heated under reflux with acidified potassium dichromate(VI) solution.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: State the colour change that takes place in the reaction mixture.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Construct an equation to represent reaction 3. Use [O] to represent an atom of oxygen from the oxidising agent.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$ reacts with an unsaturated alcohol $\mathbf{R}$ to form unsaturated ester $\mathbf{S}$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: State the **type** of reaction that forms $\mathbf{S}$.
